verdict.rationale: Crossmint is API-first and documents headless operation. Its headless checkout is a set of REST APIs that support server-side API keys and work outside a browser environment. Agent wallets also transact through a delegated signer with "no user prompt per action", so server-side, non-interactive automation is the native mode. missing for 10: no official CLI or CI-specific guidance; no staging environment for agent checkouts, which hampers CI testing; agent checkouts are poll-only with no webhooks in v1; no published OpenAPI spec (probe 404s); no independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
